settings.clientDetails: Can-Am Wireless LLC (canamwireless.com) is a privately held, minority-owned company founded in 2001, with offices in Cedar Park and Austin, Texas, and Toronto, Ontario. It started in corporate wireless accessories and now supplies IT hardware, mobility services and fleet telematics to enterprise and government customers. Its fleet telematics work is a partnership with Geotab: GPS fleet tracking, reporting, AI dash cams and driver-distraction prevention.
